title: "we're using only 10% of our brains due to market segmentation": a reply to a joke about fused-off neurons
summary: On Sun 15 Nov members were discussing a report, posted by an account outside the cluster, that an 8GB graphics card could be unlocked to its full 80GB of memory, and why chips are sold with capacity switched off. At 19:04Z @thebadcode.com (3,077 followers) quote-posted that report with "[2027 VOICE]:" and "yeah so it turns out God shipped the fruit fly connectome with an extra 20k neurons, they were just fused off" (108 likes). At 20:17Z @refinement.systems (affine, 570 followers) replied: "we're using only 10% of our brains due to market segmentation" (31 likes), and six minutes later added: "unrelated to how we lose a lot of synapses after early childhood, that's just binning" (11 likes). @thebadcode.com then quote-posted the first reply; the text of that quote post is only a truncated link.
